brief: A display stand with the large platform on a spike where three bases meet.

requirements.requirement: Large platform on a spike where three bases meet
requirements.evidence: Spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 with variant mount and accessory platform-lrg (spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0)

finish.summary: Built triangular 3-base cluster with mount spike at central junction carrying large platform, capped and locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your display stand is coming up — I'll place the large platform spike precisely where the three bases meet.

warnings.message: 1 part(s) could slide apart (1 piece(s)); joint bolts lock them.
2 part(s) could slide apart (2 piece(s)); joint bolts lock them.

offersNear.note: Open offers at the base just added (valid until the next change): apply one by its socket, no find_sockets needed.

events.text: I've set the tripod of bases — now I'll mount that large display platform right at the junction.

result.note: A spike stands where three bases meet at a corner: place three bases around one junction first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

outcomes.message: a solid spike cannot carry a platform; only a mount spike can: details.steps fits a mount spike on the same junction, then the platform.
a solid spike cannot carry a platform; only a mount spike can: details.steps fits a mount spike on the same junction, then the platform.

result.rollback: Nothing in this batch is on the build: one op was refused, so every op in it was undone. Fix or drop the refused op and send the batch again (a refusal with details.steps gives the whole batch with it fixed: send those ops as one apply); refs and offers from this batch do not exist.

events.text: Platform secured — now I'll finish the build and check the final details.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
